name: Loyalty points
summary: Counts points for every buy. It takes no fee and changes no price.
rules: After every buy the buyer earns one point for each set amount of SOL sent.
A buyer opens a points account once and pays its rent. A buy without one goes through and earns nothing.
It takes no fee and cannot change the price or the pool fee.
The pool never calls it on a sell.
The SOL per point is set at launch. Nobody can change it afterwards.
The points are a counter on chain. This hook gives them no other use.
author: The hook kit

args.name: quote_per_point
args.label: SOL a buyer sends per point
args.help: With 0.01 here, a buy of 0.1 SOL earns 10 points.
